definitions.alpha_deg: true final rotation error (GT meta vs Final meta), deg
definitions.t_cm: true final translation error |t|, cm (t_x right, t_y down, t_z forward, GT camera frame)
definitions.t_star_cm: translation that best compensates alpha in the image (GT depth at matched keypoints), cm
definitions.rot_equiv_cm: alpha_perp * Z_harm: back-of-envelope translation equivalent of the rotation error, cm
definitions.eps_cm: |t - t*|: translation error not explained by rotation compensation, cm
definitions.eps_lat_cm: lateral (perpendicular to optical axis) part of eps: visible in the image, cm
definitions.eps_fwd_cm: forward (optical axis) part of eps, signed: weakly observable, cm
definitions.eps_lat_px: eps_lat converted to pixels at the harmonic-mean keypoint depth
definitions.deadband_cm: settle-px * Z_harm / f: lateral offset the settle threshold allows, cm
definitions.Z_harm_m: harmonic-mean GT depth at the matched keypoints, m
definitions.rms_px_final: RMS reprojection displacement of the GT points in the final camera, px
definitions.est_rot_deg: rotation error the algorithm estimated at the stop (last dataLog row), deg
definitions.start_overlap: fraction of GT image pixels inside the start camera's image (sky at infinity)
definitions.clip_start: CLIP ViT-B/32 cosine similarity, Start capture vs GT rgb
definitions.clip_end: CLIP ViT-B/32 cosine similarity, End capture vs GT rgb
definitions.clip_final_rgb: CLIP ViT-B/32 cosine similarity, Final snapshot rgb.png vs GT rgb
definitions.ue_pos_err_{x,y,z}_cm: last MotionLog drone position - GT MotionLog drone position, UE world, cm (as clip_comparison.py)
definitions.ue_{pitch,yaw}_err_deg: last MotionLog camera pitch/yaw - GT, deg (as clip_comparison.py)
definitions.error_over_time: [time since start s, rotation error deg, translation error cm] every 5th MotionLog row
definitions.rot_est_err_all_deg: median over frames of |estimated - true rotation error| (dataLog vs MotionLog), deg
definitions.rot_est_err_conv_deg: same, frames with true rotation error < 1.0 deg (converged phase)
definitions.rot_est_err_conv_rmse_deg: RMS of |estimated - true| over the converged frames, deg
definitions.rot_est_held_frac: fraction of frames whose rotation estimate equals the previous frame's (held value)
definitions.rot_est_step_conv_deg: mean frame-to-frame change of the rotation estimate, converged frames, deg
definitions.rot_track_offset_s: time offset aligning the dataLog to the MotionLog (fitted per trial), s
definitions.rotation_tracking: [t s (MotionLog time), |true| deg, |estimated| deg, |est - true| deg, held 0/1], every 2nd frame
